title: Thesis integrity review (post-lock adversarial red-team)
description: The thesis-integrity module's structured output. Written to screener/runs/<SIG_ID>/thesis_integrity_review.json by screener-thesis-integrity-synthesis, once per thesis (re-runs append _v2, _v3, ... per the pre_mortem.json append-only convention, never overwrite). Applies CLAUDE.md §8 (disconfirmation standard) to a LOCKED thesis_record.json BEFORE candidate-surfacing spends real ticker-mapping work on it. Never edits thesis_record.json (locked fields cannot be overwritten) — this is a separate, read-only, append-only verdict that the orchestrator's generic routing-contract gate (frameworks/screener/SCREENER_PIPELINE.md) uses to decide whether candidate-surfacing runs.

original_routing_outcome.description: M0_6_6.routing_outcome restated from the locked thesis_record.json — this module only ever runs on a provisional/full_machine thesis.

adversarial_direction.description: Which side of the thesis is attacked — e.g. 'steelman the harmed-party / short case against the primary direct-beneficiary tier', mirroring research pre-mortem §2.

world_change_attack.description: Attacks M0_2's quantified magnitude/baseline — is the 'already occurred' change as significant as claimed, or is the baseline cherry-picked?

variant_perception_attack.description: Attacks M0_6_3 — is the claimed edge real and provable, or already priced in (Mauboussin/Marks second-level test)?

mispricing_reason_attack.description: Attacks M0_6_4 — are the three verifiable facts actually independent, or circular/weak?

convergence_trigger_attack.description: Attacks M0_6_5's causal_mechanism — does every step actually hold, or is one hand-wavy / already reflected in price?

is_fireproof.description: true = the kill switch (M0_5) is set so far from plausible outcomes it could never fire before the M0_4 horizon ends — an unfalsifiable thesis in practice, the single most important attack this module makes.

base_rate_check.description: CLAUDE.md §9 — does the implied magnitude/timeline sit within a plausible base rate for this class of event?

edge_score_haircut_note.description: Plain-English advisory only — the locked M0_6_6.final_score is never edited. E.g. 'edge score 79 would read closer to 65 if the fireproof kill-switch and coverage-gap weaknesses below were priced in'.

confidence_note.description: One plain sell-side sentence, CLAUDE.md §21 — what the review found and what it means for the human deciding whether to shortlist candidates.
